summary.name: Zapier ChatGPT (OpenAI) Integration
summary.one_liner: Zapier's integration page for connecting ChatGPT (OpenAI) actions and triggers to thousands of other apps through no-code workflows, an MCP server, or a developer SDK.
use_cases: Send Google Forms responses to ChatGPT and write the reply to a Google Sheet
Classify or moderate text and images with OpenAI models inside a workflow
Let AI agents like Claude or Cursor call ChatGPT actions via Zapier MCP
Call ChatGPT actions from backend scripts or agent code with the Zapier SDK
Automate repetitive office tasks by connecting ChatGPT to other apps
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Zapier as a no-code automation tool that lets users build workflows where a trigger in one app starts an action in ChatGPT (OpenAI), such as sending prompts, analyzing images, moderating content, or classifying text. It lists supported ChatGPT actions including message, image analysis, moderation, text classification, and assistant-style actions with settings like model, max tokens, temperature, and top P. For developers, it offers a Zapier MCP install so AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can call ChatGPT actions with authentication handled once, and a Zapier SDK (npm package) for running ChatGPT actions from code. The page states 9,000+ apps connect through Zapier and mentions audit trails, access controls, and SOC 2 and GDPR compliance.
notable: Zapier MCP lets AI agents call ChatGPT and 9,000+ other app actions with credentials kept out of the AI and per-action control
Zapier SDK (TypeScript/npm) can run ChatGPT actions such as analyze_images_responses_api from backend code
Includes audit trails, access controls, SOC 2 and GDPR compliance claims
Listed in the awesome-ai-tools collection under AI-related tools
caveats: Page says a free tier is available but does not give limits or paid plan prices
Direct API calls through fetch are not yet subject to org-level app and action restrictions
Feature set and action names are as shown on the page and may change
